newsitem.title: JAPAN: India to maintain easy credit policy - minister.
newsitem.headline: India to maintain easy credit policy - minister.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister Palaniappan Chidambaram told Reuters Financial Television on Wednesday that India's current credit policy would probably be good for the next six months.
"What we've done now should be good for another six months," Chidambaram said in the interview in Tokyo.
The minister was responding to a question about the possibility of measures in addition to last month's two-phase cut in bank reserve requirements.
The minister said there was the possibility that too much money supply would increase inflation.
He said interest rates had come down.
"Prime lending rates of most banks have been cut by 1-1/2 percent," Chidambaram said.
